nodes.name: Survivor foundations
nodes.description: Innate survival foundations and pistol proficiency. Every development path begins here; training never grants equipment.

nodes.name: Reload drill
nodes.description: Personal reload duration is multiplied by 0.80; minimum reload remains 0.65 s.

nodes.name: Steady hands
nodes.description: Add 8 personal firearm damage per projectile. Pistol trigger pulls remain capped below a fresh target's full health.

nodes.name: SMG proficiency
nodes.description: Equip an owned SMG: rapid individual projectiles, short magazines and frequent reloads. Buy or loot the gun separately.

nodes.name: Shotgun proficiency
nodes.description: Equip an owned shotgun. Each shell launches an authored fan of pellets. Buy or loot the weapon separately.

nodes.name: Rifle proficiency
nodes.description: Equip an owned rifle for balanced damage and sustained fire. Training does not supply the weapon.

nodes.name: Controlled penetration
nodes.description: Personal projectiles penetrate one additional enemy.

nodes.name: Rapid cycling
nodes.description: Multiply personal shot interval by 0.85. Faster fire also empties the magazine faster.

nodes.name: Marksman proficiency
nodes.description: Equip an owned marksman rifle for deliberate, heavy single shots. Buy or loot the weapon separately.

nodes.name: Machine gun proficiency
nodes.description: Equip an owned machine gun: large magazines and sustained fire, offset by long reloads.

nodes.name: Stopping power
nodes.description: Multiply all personal firearm damage by 1.25 after flat damage upgrades.

nodes.name: Combat reload
nodes.description: A further 15% reduction to personal reload duration stacks with Reload drill.

nodes.name: Field fitness
nodes.description: Gain 35 maximum personal health on every new attempt.

nodes.name: Emergency aid
nodes.description: Personal active: restore up to 35 health once per attempt.

nodes.name: Brace the line
nodes.description: Personal active: reduce incoming damage for five seconds, spending 30 stamina.

nodes.name: Endurance drill
nodes.description: Gain 40 maximum personal stamina for additional melee strikes and bracing.

nodes.name: Contact sweep
nodes.description: Personal melee also strikes adjacent eligible contact lanes.

nodes.name: Hardened survivor
nodes.description: Gain 3 personal armor against contact damage.

nodes.name: Heavy strike
nodes.description: Add 22 personal melee damage to every successful strike, including sweep targets.

nodes.name: Veteran vitality
nodes.description: Gain a further 50 maximum personal health; stacks with Field fitness.

nodes.name: Field engineering
nodes.description: Shared: structures gain 25% durability and damage in personal and NPC deployments.

nodes.name: Reinforced frames
nodes.description: Shared: multiply structure durability and damage by a further 1.20.

nodes.name: Defensive fabrication
nodes.description: Shared: multiply structure durability and damage by a further 1.20.

nodes.name: Outpost mastery
nodes.description: Shared: multiply structure durability and damage by a further 1.25.

nodes.name: Grenade handling
nodes.description: Unlock the grenade action with two renewed charges each attempt. Detonations damage nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Incendiary handling
nodes.description: Unlock the Molotov action with two renewed charges each attempt. Burning ground damages enemies over time.

nodes.name: Blast packing
nodes.description: Multiply grenade and incendiary damage by 1.30.

nodes.name: Grenade bandolier
nodes.description: Gain two additional renewed grenade charges each attempt.

nodes.name: Bottle carrier
nodes.description: Gain two additional renewed Molotov charges each attempt.

nodes.name: Wide blast
nodes.description: Multiply grenade blast and incendiary ground radius by 1.25.

nodes.name: Slow burn
nodes.description: Incendiary ground remains active 50% longer.

nodes.name: Quick throw
nodes.description: Multiply the shared ordnance action cooldown by 0.70.
